name: 10pines-c6-gameoflife
title: Conway's Game of Life
description: Conway's Game of Life on a bounded board of Point cells: create a game from its live cells and board size (cells outside the board are rejected), ask whether a cell is alive or dead, count live neighbours and compute the next generation from the survival and birth rules. Built from scratch with TDD; the exercise is defined by the course's solution file since no slide defines it.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C6 - Construccion de Software Seguro usando Test Driven Development

design.notes: Representing the grid as a set of live cells versus a matrix, and computing all cell transitions simultaneously from the previous generation, are the design decisions the tests drive out.
